Update to Day 193 conjecture. For general a: c_{a-l}(r) = (q-1)/q^a · [r+2l-a]/([2][3]...[l]) · P_l(q,t;r,a). P_l is polynomial of degree l-1 in q; coefficient of q^{l-1-j} has t-exponent binom(j+1,2), alternating signs. Concrete: P_2 = q[r+3-a] - t[r+1-a]; P_3 = [r+5-a][r+4-a]q^2 - t[2][r+2-a][r+4-a]q + t^3[r+1-a][r+2-a]; P_4 = [r+7-a][r+6-a][r+5-a]q^3 - t[3][r+3-a][r+5-a][r+6-a]q^2 + t^3[3][r+2-a][r+3-a][r+5-a]q - t^6[r+1-a][r+2-a][r+3-a]. Verified l=1,2,3,4 for a=4 across r=3,4,5.
